subject: UAV FLIGHTS, IN SUPPORT OF HELLENIC POLICE-COAST GUARD OPERATIONS
text:
A3919/26 NOTAMN
Q) LGGG/QWULW/IV/BO /W /120/130/3850N02558E038
A) LGGG B) 2610271200 C) 2611051800
D) OCT 27 29 1200-1800, NOV 03 05 1200-1800
E) UAV FLIGHTS, IN SUPPORT OF HELLENIC POLICE-COAST GUARD OPERATIONS
WILL TAKE PLACE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:
1.- AREA: 392424N 0254154E - 391850N 0262634E - 391200N 0262500E -
381247N 0260001E - 382030N 0254328E - 390601N 0260721E - 
390931N 0253906E - 392424N 0254154E.  
AWYS Y94 AND H59 (NILVA-MES), G18 AND L608 (MOCNA-MES), G802 AND Y134
(PANOX-HOS), G8 AND N604 (ATSOV-AMANI), N127 AND N128 (LMO-ADHOT),
L618 (ADHOT-MES), N130 (PIVOS-MES), P14 (LMO-ERESO), MITILINI TMA
AFFECTED.
2.- PROCEDURES FOR UNIT CONDUCTING THE ACTIVITIES:
2.1.- FLIGHT PLANS MUST BE SUBMITTED AND PERMISSION BY APPROPRIATE
ATC UNIT MUST BE OBTAINED.
2.2.- OUT OF TMAS, THE LIAISONS OF THE UNIT CONDUCTING THE ACTIVITIES
SHALL ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH ATHINAI CONTROL.
3.- PROCEDURES FOR NON EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
3.1.- IN THE INTEREST OF SAFETY DURING ACTIVITIES, NON EXERCISE
AIRCRAFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE AREA DESIGNATED
IN PARA (1) ABOVE.
3.2- OTHER AIRCRAFT UNABLE TO AVOID THE ABOVE DESCRIBED AREA WILL BE
AUTHORIZED TO ENTER THIS AREA AFTER SPECIAL PERMISSION
BY APPROPRIATE ATC UNIT.
F) FL120 G) FL130
